item.title: FDNY faced with 2 critical challenges in Queens fire that killed 83-year-old man
item.description: The FDNY faced two critical challenges - a non-working hydrant and a car parked on a hydrant at the scene.

item.title: MTA opens new front in war on Long Island Rail Road fare evasion
item.description: The Long Island Rail Road has stepped up its crackdown on fare beaters, which includes strict new measures that some riders are unhappy about.

item.title: NYC nonprofit's annual tennis tournament helps change young students' lives
item.description: A New York-based nonprofit whose goal is to change young lives through tennis and education kicked off its annual Presidents' Cup Tournament on Monday.

item.title: Swan rescued from frozen pond in Rye, taken to wildlife facility
item.description: First responders came to the rescue of a swan that got stuck to the surface of a frozen pond in Rye, Westchester County.

item.title: Body found in woods in Manorville identified as missing woman, officials say
item.description: Officers discovered a dead body in a wooded area in Suffolk County last week while searching for a missing woman.

item.title: Taylor Swift concert attack plot leads to terrorism charges against 21-year-old man
item.description: Austrian public prosecutors filed terrorism-related charges Monday against a 21-year-old defendant who they say planned to carry out an attack on one of superstar singer Taylor Swift's concerts in Vienna in August 2024.

item.title: Logan Paul's Pikachu Illustrator Pokémon card sells for record $16.5M
item.description: On Monday, the Pikachu Illustrator card sold at Goldin Auctions after 41 days of bidding.

item.title: More than 10 arrested as police break up large crowd of teens outside Baychester mall: sources
item.description: NewsCopter 7 was over the scene in the Baychester section, where crowds of teens scattered and started running in several different directions outside the Mall at Bay Plaza.

item.title: Person pulled to safety following rescue on Ed Koch Queensboro Bridge: FDNY
item.description: Fire officials say they received a report of a person down a shaft just before 9 p.m. at the Manhattan-bound lower level of the bridge.

item.title: Several people, including children, rescued from raging house fire in Mamaroneck
item.description: Several people, including children, were rescued from the fire and brought to Jacobi Medical Center for smoke inhalation, according to officials.
